name: ezimage
description: The ultimate effortless multi-platform image uploader for VS Code. Support R2, S3 and more.
author: Kiang (keepwonder)

commands.title: Upload Clipboard Image As…
commands.description: Pick the insert format (Markdown / HTML center / HTML figure) for this upload only.

ezimage.provider.description:
## Storage

Where uploaded images are stored. Currently only **Cloudflare R2** is wired in. AWS S3, Aliyun OSS, and Tencent COS are roadmap items.

ezimage.r2.accountId.description: Cloudflare Account ID. Found in the Cloudflare dashboard sidebar.

ezimage.r2.accessKeyId.description: R2 API token Access Key ID. Generate at *R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token*.

ezimage.r2.secretAccessKey.description: R2 API token Secret Access Key. Shown once when the token is created — copy immediately.

ezimage.r2.bucketName.description: Name of the R2 bucket images are uploaded into. Create one at *R2 → Create bucket* if you don't have one.

ezimage.r2.publicUrl.description: Public distribution URL for the bucket, e.g. `https://pub-xxxx.r2.dev`. Enable *Public Access* on the bucket and copy the URL from the bucket settings page.

ezimage.pathTemplate.markdownDescription:
Path template for uploaded objects.

---

Available variables: `{yyyy}` `{MM}` `{dd}` `{hh}` `{mm}` `{ss}` `{timestamp}` `{random}` `{name}` `{ext}`.

Example: `{yyyy}/{MM}/{timestamp}-{random}.{ext}` produces `2026/09/1736422488123-abc123.png`.

ezimage.compress.markdownDescription:
## Compression

Enable WebP conversion before upload. Disable if you want pixel-perfect originals or your bucket already handles optimization.

ezimage.maxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels. Images wider than this are downscaled before encoding. Set to `0` to keep original dimensions. Most blog readers don't benefit from widths beyond 1920.

ezimage.quality.description: WebP quality (1–100). Higher = larger files, better fidelity. 80–85 is a good sweet spot for screenshots.

ezimage.autoInstallSharp.description: When `sharp` is missing, prompt to install the native binary on first use. Requires Node.js ≥ 18.17 and `npm` on `PATH`.

ezimage.disableCompressionNotice.description: Suppress the warning shown when the sharp compression engine is unavailable (e.g. on an Electron/Node ABI mismatch).

ezimage.insertFormat.markdownDescription:
## Insert format

How the upload appears in your Markdown document.

---

**Common choices:**

- `markdown` for plain blog posts
- `html-wrap` for HTML centering with a width attribute
- `html-figure` for semantic documentation with captions

See [Insert format templates](https://github.com/keepwonder/ezimage#insert-format-templates) for details and variables.

ezimage.insertWidth.description: Width attribute for HTML templates (`{width}`). Examples: `65%` for responsive images, `600px` for a fixed size, `auto` for natural size. Empty = omit the width attribute entirely.

ezimage.insertAlign.description:
Alignment for HTML templates. `none` drops the wrapper `
` entirely — pick this when you want a bare `` with just a width attribute.

ezimage.insertCustomTemplate.markdownDescription: Custom insert template, used when `ezimage.insertFormat = 'custom'`. --- Variables: `{url}` `{filename}` `{name}` `{ext}` `{width}` `{align}` `{alt}`. Example: `{alt}` Unknown placeholders are left as-is so typos are visible.

ezimage.insertIncludeName.description: Use the source filename as the alt text / figcaption. Recommended for SEO and screen readers.

ezimage.language.markdownDescription:
## Language

Display language for EzImage prompts, errors, and info messages.

---

`auto` follows VS Code's display language. The Settings panel labels themselves always follow VS Code (not this setting) — that limitation is described in [the README](https://github.com/keepwonder/ezimage#what-gets-translated).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run verify && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run compile && python3 scripts/package-vsix.py --verify ezimage-dev.vsix
